items.mainDefect: The sender metadata lookup can raise KeyError when sender is absent, causing a 500 instead of a graceful verification failure.

secondary.defect: The case-sensitive login comparison can reject a legitimate installer whose GitHub login differs only in case.

items.mainDefect: The test omits OAuth mocks, so it exits through an OAuth error before exercising the missing-installation handling.

secondary.defect: The assertion checks an error message shared by multiple failure branches, so it cannot establish that the missing-installation branch ran.
